answer: Down at the quay the fisherman counts his hauls aloud, and the men mending nets beside him hear every number. Proof of fisherman catch via net haul count is the counting: a catch the fisherman lands only after 7 hauls are drawn, each haul counted at the quay. The hollow is the first haul, drawn before sunrise; the quill is the seventh, drawn when the tide turned. A cheat must draw 13 false hauls and mend 13 false nets, and the umber still smells of no fish from his boat.
